hints.title: Root Value Uniformity
hints.text: Every node in the tree must match the value of the root node.

hints.title: Recursive Equality Check
hints.text: A tree is univalued if its root matches the expected target value and both left and right subtrees are univalued.

hints.title: Simple Traversal Conjunction
hints.text: Save val = root.val. Traverse with a helper function: if node is None return True. If node.val does not equal val, return False. Return helper(node.left) and helper(node.right).

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all node pairs takes O(N^2) time; comparing each node once against the root is strictly linear.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Depth traversal visits each node once and uses recursion stack memory proportional to tree height.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should provide an early-exit traversal that halts immediately on the first mismatched node value.
complexity.notes: Can be written in a single line: not root or ((not root.left or root.val == root.left.val) and (not root.right or root.val == root.right.val) and isUnivalTree(root.left) and isUnivalTree(root.right)).
